subject: Fade peds between the camera and the player
description: Dithered fade (psDynamic/psHairCard clip on gObjParams2.z, DrawItem.fade) for non-player peds occluding the player close to the camera, plus a soft near-camera fade replacing the hard 0.55 m skip; smoothed per ped; FP/scripted cameras only use the near fade. Verify with a Wine shot.
